ontology.included: Visible line-attached insulator strings/assemblies, including vertical suspension and horizontal/diagonal strain-like assemblies.
ontology.excluded: Substation/gantry post insulators and ambiguous equipment not clearly serving as an overhead-line insulator assembly.

annotation_process: Candidate selection was committed from direct pixel review before model proposals. YOLOE-26 v4.1 proposals were then used only as an annotation aid. Final boxes below were manually accepted/corrected against source pixels; proposals were not auto-converted to ground truth.
claim_boundary: Assistant-provisional portfolio reference only; not independently adjudicated engineering ground truth; no material, condition, corrosion, defect, failure, or safety claim.

records.excluded_visible_objects: Large porcelain/brown post insulators on the lower substation-like gantry are intentionally excluded from this overhead-line string ontology.
